name: story-review-stop-embedding-requirements-corpus
title: Stop story_review from embedding the requirements corpus
description: Remove unconditional recursive requirements Markdown reads and full truthDocs concatenation from story_review _reviewPrompt so ordinary PLAN review cannot consume the entire multi-megabyte corpus. Preserve PLAN gate semantics and structured story, understanding, decision, checklist, verificationIntent, grill, experience-hint, and ProofStory sections. Add regression coverage proving unrelated large requirements documents are not embedded and prompt size does not scale with corpus content.
